import os,glob,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))

    c=Counter(v for r in g for v in r)

def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r); bg=max(cnt,key=cnt.get)
    o=[r[:] for r in g]
    for comp in comps(g,bg):
        rs={p[0] for p in comp}; cs_={p[1] for p in comp}
        if len(rs)==1 and len(cs_)==1:  # marker: shoot down until blocked, then ->4
            mr,mc=comp[0]
            for r in range(mr+1,H):
                if g[r][mc]!=bg: break
                o[r][mc]=g[mr][mc]
            o[mr][mc]=4
        elif len(rs)==1:                 # horizontal block: beam at L+1,L+2 with block's color
            row=comp[0][0]; L=min(cs_); R=max(cs_)
            for j in (L+1,L+2):
                if 0<=j<W:
                    for r in range(row+1,H):
                        if g[r][j]!=bg: break
                        o[r][j]=g[row][L]
            for (r,c) in comp: o[r][c]=4
        else:                             # vertical object: extend downward from bottom
            col=comp[0][1]; lo,hi=min(rs),max(rs)
            for r in range(hi+1,H):
                if g[r][col]!=bg: break
                o[r][col]=g[lo][col]
            for (r,c) in comp: o[r][c]=4
    return o

```python
def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=max(set(x for r in g for x in r),key=lambda v:sum(r.count(v) for r in g))
    # components of non-bg
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if g[r][c]!=bg and (r,c) not in seen:
                v=g[r][c]; stack=[(r,c)]; comp=set()
                while stack:
                    rr,cc=stack.pop()
                    if (rr,cc) in seen: continue
                    seen.add((rr,cc)); comp.add((rr,cc))
                    for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        nr,nc=rr+dr,cc+dc
                        if 0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<W and g[nr][nc]==v: stack.append((nr,nc))
                comps.append(comp)
    o=[[bg]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for comp in comps:
        rs={p[0] for p in comp}; cs={p[1] for p in comp}
        if len(rs)==1 and len(cs)>1:   # horizontal bar
            row=L=min(rs); L=min(cs)
            for j in (L+1,L+2):
                if j<W:
                    rr=row+1
                    while rr<H and g[rr][j]==bg:
                        o[rr][j]=g[comp[0][0]][comp[0][1]]  # ? color
                        rr+=1
            for (r_,c_) in comp: o[r_][c_]=g[r_][c_]
        elif len(cs)==1 and len(rs)>1: # vertical bar
            pass # nothing (or shoot horizontally?)
        else:                           # marker: shoot down own color, ->4
            mr,mc=next(iter(comp))
            for rr in range(mr+1,H):
                if g[rr][mc]!=bg: break
                o[rr][mc]=g[mr][mc]
            o[mr][mc]=4
    return o
```

```python
def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=max(set(x for r in g for x in r),key=lambda v:sum(r.count(v) for r in g))
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if g[r][c]!=bg and (r,c) not in seen:
                v=g[r][c]; stack=[(r,c)]; comp=set()
                while stack:
                    rr,cc=stack.pop()
                    if (rr,cc) in seen: continue
                    seen.add((rr,cc)); comp.add((rr,cc))
                    for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        nr,nc=rr+dr,cc+dc
                        if 0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<W and g[nr][nc]==v: stack.append((nr,nc))
                comps.append(comp)
    o=[[bg]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for comp in comps:
        rs={p[0] for p in comp}; cs={p[1] for p in comp}
        if len(rs)==1 and len(cs)>1:   # horizontal bar: keep color, shoot down at cols L+1,L+2 (only within grid), stop before any non-bg
            row=min(rs); L=min(cs); v=g[row][L]
            for j in (L+1,L+2):
                if j<W:
                    rr=row+1
                    while rr<H and g[rr][j]==bg:
                        o[rr][j]=3; rr+=1
            for (r_,c_) in comp: o[r_][c_]=v
        elif len(cs)==1 and len(rs)>1: # vertical bar: shoot right at rows lo+1,lo+2 (in-bounds), stopping at non-bg
            col=min(cs_); lo,hi=min(rs),max(rs)
            for i in (lo+1,lo+2):
                if 0<=i<H:
                    cc=col+1
                    while cc<W and g[i][cc]==bg:
                        o[i][cc]=3; cc+=1
            for (r_,c_) in comp: o[r_][c_]=v
        else:                           # marker: shoot down own color, become 4
            mr,mc=next(iter(comp))
            for rr in range(mr+1,H):
                if g[rr][mc]!=bg: break
                o[rr][mc]=g[mr][mc]
            o[mr][mc]=4
    return o
```
